title: StartTask
description: Start a task on the tinycomputer module; follow it with AwaitTask and ContinueTask.

task.description: The goal in plain language; needs a planner.

flow.description: A flow written from the guide Describe returns.

facts.description: Values the task may type, by name. Shared ones brief the decision model; card, passport, password, and one-time-code values are secret and only ever shown to a model as ${name}.

secret_facts.description: Names among facts to keep secret as well.

payment.description: Stop at the control that pays (default), or fill the payment form from secret facts and wait for approval to pay; the latter needs origins.

votes.description: How many ways each decision is asked before its answers are averaged.

strategy.description: How each decision is asked: many small requests (narrow, the default), or one request per turn over a digest of the screen with a working memory (wide).

deliberation.description: How much each decision is deliberated before acting: deep (the default) escalates close calls with more framings, pairwise duels, and contrasting questions, checks every action's effect, and undoes and retries mistakes; standard does less; off uses single thresholds.

max_rescues.description: How many failed steps a reasoning model may rescue with guidance before the task fails (default and most 3; 0 turns rescues off). Needs the module's planner configuration.
